# Bundled interface dependencies

- Bootstrap 5.3.3: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5.3.3
- Bootstrap Icons 1.11.3: https://github.com/twbs/icons/tree/v1.11.3

Both use the MIT license; copies are included in their respective directories. Assets were downloaded from their version-pinned npm distributions through jsDelivr. Only unavailable source-map comments were removed from the Bootstrap CSS/JS files. Keep these pinned assets in the repository so the local presentation interface does not depend on a live CDN.
